title: Age Calculator
h1: Age Calculator — Exact Age in Years, Months, Days
seoTitle: Free Age Calculator — Calculate Exact Age Online
description: Calculate your exact age in years, months, and days from a birth date. Also shows total days lived and next birthday. Private and instant.
intro: Enter a birth date. See precise age, total days, and days until the next birthday.
blurb: Calculate exact age from birth date with years, months, and days.
howItWorks: Select or type a birth date.
The calculator computes the difference to today.
See years, months, days, total days lived, and next birthday countdown.
examples: Someone born 1990-05-15 is currently in their mid-30s.
Use to find exact age for forms or just curiosity.
See how many days until the next birthday.

faq.q: Does it account for leap years?
faq.a: Yes. The calculation uses proper date arithmetic including leap days.

faq.q: What if the birth date is in the future?
faq.a: It will show a negative or zero result; choose a past date for age.

faq.q: Is the date sent to a server?
faq.a: No. All computation happens locally in your browser.
